reviews.author: Justina Sanders
reviews.text: I had an awesome experience with Masseys. My car was ready in 2 hours after front and rear aligning plus tire rods and wheel bearings. I was treated so nicely. They gave me a warm clean lounge just outside the garage. They were super friendly and quick with the service. I was riding around back smooth riding and satisfied.

reviews.author: Barry Toole
reviews.text: Friendly, knowledgeable folks. Very reasonable prices. The "go to" place for alignment and suspension needs..

reviews.author: Robert-Cynthia Harrington
reviews.text: I rebuilt the front end of my 2005 Tahoe myself. I took it to Masseys for an alignment after I finished. I specifically told them that I rebuilt it myself and to check over everything. 90 days later this is what I have. I tightened it by hand because I didn't have far to drive to get it to them or a wrench big enough. You can clearly see there are no wrench marks on the inner tierod knuckle. They did not check it. Luckily I wasn't on the highway when it came loose today. Only explanation I got from them was there technician checked everything. I call BS !!

reviews.author: Taylor E.
reviews.text: Great place. Very professional and seem to care about their customer as well as their work. They will always be my first stop when it comes to unknown mechanical issues.

reviews.author: Robbie Johnson
reviews.text: Have used and recommended this place many times over the years for brakes, suspension and wheel alignment issues....best in the business and treated like a daily customer if you've haven't been in over a year....highly recommended

reviews.author: Brian Harrison
reviews.text: They did an excellent job on the alignment of my classic car. Other shops couldn't do it with their computerized systems, but the guys at Massey's had no issues. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: graffjl
reviews.text: I have been here twice now in the last two years and both times the staff have been consistently helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable whether over the phone or in person. I will not hesitate to recommend and use this shop in the future.

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.text: My husband and I were driving back home to FL and while we were in NC, our front right tire was flat! I was so worried being in a different state with no help. I googled places near by and this was one of them. This place had the best reviews plus it wasn’t a corporation. I couldn’t be more grateful for the people who worked there. They were so friendly, so helpful and we were in and out of there with a brand new tire. Thank you Massey’s for all the help! Made our situation less stressful. Definitely recommend this place! Thank you so much again!!!!

reviews.author: Daniel Scott
reviews.text: I had my son take his truck to get aligned, they tried scamming him into needing more work. I just replaced everything under the front end of his truck with Detroit axle parts. This included a arms, ball joints, sway bar bushings, control arms and I even replaced the rag joint. They told my son he needed to replace everything I just finished changing including the gear box. This is the 3rd and final time I'll ever try to use them for services as this is what happens every time I try to take a vehicle to get aligned.

reviews.author: Roger Johnson
reviews.text: Went in for an inspection on my car. I did not have an appointment, but they took me right away. They are good at their job. Within 10 minutes I was done. They have been at this location since 1962, so they are well established in the Selma Community. I would recommend them to anyone looking for an inspection. They also do wheel alignment and brakes. They have a great reputation and all of their employees are very responsive and professional. I highly recommend this establishment.

reviews.author: Roger Starland
reviews.text: Dropped our jeep off for alignment, rotation, and balancing on Wednesday and picked it up Thursday morning. Paid cash (10% less than what it would have been if I paid with CC). I know where I’m bring my truck for new tires and alignment. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Ed Perry
reviews.text: Very friendly people. Was able to get an appointment for RV alignment and stabilizer install in a very reasonable amount of time. When I got there at the appointment time they took my vehicle right in. Comfortable little lounge for waiting. Will definitely be using them for all of my RV tire, brake, mechanical needs

reviews.author: Pat Gordon
reviews.text: Massey's saved our trip back home to South Carolina. We had a nasty blowout on 95 and they were able to work us in immediately. It was near closing time but they didn't hesitate to accommodate us. It was refreshing to deal with such caring people.

reviews.author: Jessica Forte
reviews.text: Had a first visit at Massey's this morning and was very pleased. They were quick and friendly. I had to have breaks, rotors, and a front in alignment done. Best part of all the price was fair and manageable for the average person to be able to afford! Thank yall for what you do!!!

reviews.author: Shaun Cialino
reviews.text: Excellent service. We had our 31ft class C aligned and brake service done. The ladies in the office we delt with were extremely polite. They called us everytime to check with us before they performed any work. Turnaround was quick. We will definitely come back for future work on our vehicles.

reviews.author: Vikki
reviews.text: Heard good things about these guys from friends who are mechanics so I thought I'd check them out after lowering my car. First off I thought I was getting my whole car aligned for the price they quoted me over the phone, nope "just the back", I found that out after I called back about my car still pulling to one side and I was informed they "assumed I wanted only the back done" and said I needed to "schedule another appointment" to get the front done as well as pay another sixty dollars, so here I could've gotten my whole car aligned at a DEALERSHIP for $80 flat. Very poor costumer service and lack of communication, if you come here make sure it's clear what you're paying for.

reviews.author: Jason Braswell
reviews.text: If you need an alignment this is the place. I’ve heard how good they are my whole life and it’s absolutely true. I had an appointment for 4 PM and at 4:04 my Jeep was being pulled into the shop. These guys test drove the Jeep 4 times in order to get the alignment and loose steering box corrected and it now drives as straight as an arrow.

reviews.author: Cynthia Brown
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable, professional and most of all very affordable. I will recommend them to everybody I know.

reviews.author: Bill Carr
reviews.text: I used to do business with them years ago and they were awesome. I had to get a 4 wheel alinement so I took my Toyota there to get it done. Very good group of people to to business with. I highly recommend them

reviews.author: Brian Stout
reviews.text: Brought in a set of wheels to have tires mounted, guys said no problem charging 200 bucks to mount the tires I brought onto the wheels I brought and proceeded to beat the powder coat off in multiple areas on all four wheels. These wheels were over 400 bucks each. Do not bring your stuff here if you care about it at all.

reviews.author: Deborah Bunn
reviews.text: They did a great job on my alignment and also gave me advice about my tires. The wait time was not long at all. Good prices too. I will recommend.

reviews.author: Billy Briley
reviews.text: Would not recommend, trusted them with brake work,now I have an axle boot leaking and a brake fluid leak that I didn't have before took it back. The secretary stated nothing they did could have caused the damage,but for an additional 1,000,they could fix it What a bunch of crooks!!!

reviews.author: Stevo James
reviews.text: This shop came highly recommended and i see why, they do alignments the old school way and do not rush to get it done, they test drive every vehicle to assure the work is to the highest standards. Best alignment I've ever had done. 2nd time bringing my tundra here for an alignment, they are very tough to get right and once again they got it perfect. Stay clear of the chain alignment shops that are local worthless and overpriced also don't get tire balanced at the several Hispanic run shops they did mine completely wrong and balance was not ever close.

reviews.author: Bonnie Sanders
reviews.text: The service is beyond compàre. When we first moved here the Ford dealership tried to rip us off by selling us breaks and all kind of other services we did not need to fix a "major" problem. The people at Massey's fixed our major problem for$1.25. we have been dealing with them for 25 years and have never had better service anywhere.

reviews.author: Joseph Husick
reviews.text: These folks are experts and reasonable. I am in the automotive business and have taken vehicles here to correct what other shops attempted or simply failed to resolve. What I have learned is that computer alignments are only as good as the mechanic and calibration of equipment. And just because you paid almost $100 and have a computer print out of your alignment does not mean your vehicle is aligned properly. The entire staff at Massey's are experienced, honest, and just great at what they do. I witnessed one technician test drive my vehicle three times and make adjustments before he was satisfied with his work. Every vehicle I have picked up over the years was dialed in and done right the first time. And prior to moving to the area I used to drive about an hour from Raleigh and it was well worth it.

reviews.author: NeverGreen Solutions LLC
reviews.text: Brought in my truck to have a leveling kit installed that I supplied new in box! Dropped truck off and left with them all day to get a call saying it was ready. Before I made payment I took a look around the new parts installed and saw the top strut nuts missing and one loosely threaded on. Ask if problem could be addressed and mechanic said what’s loose??? After I told him which side was missing the nuts I was told ohh I know what you are talking about. The thought that goes in my mind is what would have happened if I had my family in the truck and part came off as we are driving down the highway. Much less if that was his own son or daughter driving with loose suspension parts. They did fix the issue but I would NEVER bring any of my personal or work vehicles here again due to that issue!

reviews.author: Anna Marie
reviews.text: No frills auto shop that got me in and out very quick for a great price. Very pleased with my service and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: James Parker
reviews.text: I've been there once They did a good job. Just way over priced. Which is why I'm giving them 3 stars.

reviews.author: Penny Creech
reviews.text: I am so pleased! They diagnosed and repaired my jeep quickly. They came highly recommended and I can see why. Thank you Massey's!

reviews.author: Ryan Tutor
reviews.text: Won't be back. Have been going to this place for multiple years and in the past had good service and results. Unfortunately this year I took my truck to them for my new tires to be trued and balanced. Before taking it to them I had a slight vibration at 60mph. After they did their process, the tires are ruined and vibrate so badly at all speeds that my mirrors try to shake off. I took it back and was told it was my lug nuts and my wheels were wrong. I spent the money and had new lug nuts put on but informed the tech that the wheels are Ford OEM and are hubcentric so the lug nuts should not matter. They kept my truck for over 2 hours on return and I could find that they did nothing to it to fix the problem. The tech was rude and had a poor attitude about it the whole time. So they took my $150 and ruined my brand new tires and told me it was my fault. Funny thing is the tires, wheels and lug nuts were fine with only a very slight vibration at 60mph prior to going to Massey's. I could argue and fight them on this, but at this point it's a lesson learned and I won't ever go back nor recommend anyone else for that matter to use them. HIGHLIGHTS - Employees rude, poor attitude. Their tire truing service ruined my new tires. They charged me for a service that now has me buying new replacement tires.

reviews.author: Michael Wales
reviews.text: Great, friendly, and down to earth techs that know why they are doing:highly skilled and years of knowledge at your service for an great price. Trust me, You will be glad you chose them.

reviews.author: Hunter Johnson
reviews.text: After spending nearly $250 at other shops trying to get my Caster settings correct, Massey's knocked it out in less than an hour and it's perfect. Just because you're getting a print out at techy shops showing your alignment is "green" doesn't mean it's done right (if your vehicle is modified outside of OEM specs). I will be going back to Massey's every time from now on. Price, service and overall outcome exceeded my expectations. A fancy alignment machine can't beat experience. These guys are professional front end people, not professional alignment machine operators.

reviews.author: Rhonda R.
reviews.text: Great service. Friendly staff. Had vehicle worked on and inspected...fair prices, timely repairs..would reccommend!

reviews.author: Carmelo Perez
reviews.text: I'm from out of town I was broken down shut off exit 95 in Smithfield someone referred them to me at the hotel which I had to wait for 2 days cuz nothing's open on the weekends but even Monday that was a holiday they were open they did a great job my whole wheel bearing was shot and gone they switched it out I already had the part it only took half hour 40 minutes and I was back on the road they're only open Monday to Thursday that closed Friday Saturday and Sunday but they did a great job at a very very reasonable price thank you Tim for doing such a great work.

reviews.author: Helen Braswell
reviews.text: Had to have my car inspected. It took them less than 10 minutes to complete. Would definitely recommend this place to everyone.

reviews.author: Brandon Mills
reviews.text: I showed up at 4 PM looking to get my wheel bearings checked out. They had me out the door at 4:45 with everything replaced. Great service and timing!

reviews.author: Tee Jay
reviews.text: Went an got a car looked under that I was going to purchase! They were very pleasant! Let me know it wasn't a good car!

reviews.author: Andrew Bryan
reviews.text: Excellent shop, good service with people that know what they are doing. After being told by another shop my truck couldn't be aligned because of "other problems" I took my truck to masseys and they aligned it with no problems and it drove perfect.

reviews.author: Tommy Holland
reviews.text: Absolutely best place to take your tire, brake, alignment needs. Been going here for 25 years and have always had Fantastic service at Affordable prices.

reviews.author: Lisa Bogner
reviews.text: Excellent!!! They are Wonderful people and the Best! Highly recommend if you want things done right.

reviews.author: robert Hambrick
reviews.text: Great service. They got my truck driving straight as an arrow all without using the fancy stuff. I will return from all of my alignments and possibly tires too.

reviews.author: Nell Evans
reviews.text: Awesome service, friendly, affordable, efficient, and spot-on. My family has relied on Massey's for many many years and they never disappoint.

reviews.author: Aleta Villa
reviews.text: They were so helpful and went above and beyond to fix my car . They made sure I could get into the waiting area due to me being handicap and made sure I didn't fall coming out . They are my go to for my car needs.

reviews.author: Lynn Godwin
reviews.text: These guys know their business from head to toe. Wonderful people! Had my truck fixed in hardly any time at all.

reviews.author: Richard Creech
reviews.text: Nobody beats the team at Massey's Wheel Alignment. The work they accomplish is second to none and their prices are lower than anyone and if you are not satisfied with the job they will make it right.

reviews.author: Jake
reviews.text: Massey's wheel alignment are the absolute experts when it comes to all things alignment/suspension/tire. Always fantastic customer service and they are happy to answer all of the curious customers(like myself) questions.

reviews.author: kirk kuykendoll
reviews.text: When it's about tires, brakes, and anything has to do with any vehicle riding smooth and straight these guys are "on it!" They are "TOP DOGS" in Johnston Co.

reviews.author: John Jack
reviews.text: Great service, I was traveling away from home and had a flat tire. They took me right in, fast professional service.

reviews.author: King Chef
reviews.text: These people are prejudicle crooks, and overrated. They think their in the clear of doing bad bisiness with the public. Just cause they do a lot of work for the town law enforcement

reviews.author: Paula Rhodes
reviews.text: Had tires balanced elsewhere and continued having problems. Massey's did a great job in resolving the problem and in a timely manner.

reviews.author: Otha Gatlin
reviews.text: This is one hell of a place !!! No bs no tricks and games! buying wut u don't need!if my grandson's power wheels break down its going to massy!!!

reviews.author: Larry Parker
reviews.text: I've always gone to Massey's Wheel Alignment . They're great people and quality of work is top notch.

reviews.author: Andrew M. Roy Sr
reviews.text: There is no better place for front end and alignment work. I have had both personal and commercial vehicles worked on and always top notch work!!!
